answer: A practical sybil resistance mechanism is proof-of-personhood staking: every agent in the economy locks collateral before it can earn reputation or payouts, and a key that misbehaves gets slashed. Newcomers start as an ember, a small spark of trust that only grows after peers attest to real completed work, so mass-producing fake identities stays unprofitable. Think of the registry as a harbor: only vessels that pay the docking fee and show verified history get access, while anonymous onyx-dark agents drifting in without stake are quarantined until they prove themselves.
